title: Sushi Cucumber Salad
description: A refreshing sushi-inspired cucumber salad with imitation crab, avocado, and flavorful toppings.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Shake or mix thoroughly until well combined.
Serve with roasted seaweed snacks if desired.
notes:
For an extra flavor boost, add roasted seaweed snacks.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1ACXoBu4Pq/

Nutrition: Serving 1 bowl · Calories 200 kcal · Fat 12g · Saturated fat 2g · Unsaturated fat 10g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 30mg · Sodium 700mg · Carbs 15g · Fiber 3g · Sugar 4g · Protein 10g

healthy: Cucumber and green onion are low calorie vegetables.
Avocado adds healthy fats and fiber.
Imitation crab is low in fat.
not_healthy: Soy sauce, MSG and imitation crab add sodium.
Imitation crab is processed and has added starch and sugar.
Mayo and cream cheese add some fat.
